capabilities: create notes with title, content, tags, and folder via RPC
append content to existing notes, optionally under a heading
run full-text search across the vault
list folder contents and return the vault tree
show a color-coded connection status in the status bar
disambiguation: It is not a syncing plugin; it is a server-side endpoint that an external app calls to act on the vault.
extras: README is fully duplicated in English and Russian; installation via BRAT is described; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for an external system like Jenn Core to push notes into the vault or query it over a live connection.

relations.evidence: Obsidian plugin — WebSocket endpoint for [Jenn Core]

summary: WebSocket bridge that turns Obsidian into an output destination for Jenn Core, letting it write, append, and search notes remotely.
